info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Customer Management Product Eligibilities-spec
info.description: The Customer Management Product Eligibility API enables organizations to access and evaluate customer eligibility for various banking products. This API serves as a critical resource for financial service providers looking to improve decision-making processes and enhance customer experiences. Typical consumers of this API may include customer service representatives, banking applications, and financial advisors who need to determine product suitability based on customer profiles. By providing detailed eligibility information, this API supports informed product recommendations and streamlined customer interactions.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch eligibility details for products associated with customers. It helps in determining which products a customer qualifies for based on predefined criteria.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve product eligibility information for customers. It enables the client to specify the parameters necessary to filter and obtain the relevant product eligibility data.
